title: B2 BUILD (constitutional-tier): INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md v1 at repo root - IC-NN translation, preference and procedure rules with the code-version citation duty
description: Create the new primitive the addendum introduces (section 4, DIRECTIVE; coordinator decision A3): the shared interpretive code as an explicit, versioned system artifact, identical for all sessions. Human interpreters compose their interpretive code ad hoc and privately, which is the deep source of interpretive divergence; agents need not. INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md at the repo root, sibling of PRECEDENT.md, tracked (unlike docs/, which is gitignored): translation rules (how to read a ratio), preference rules (how to rank competing readings), procedure rules (the order of application), each with a stable IC-NN id, the document carrying an explicit version. Its purpose is stated honestly: it does not eliminate indeterminacy, which is structural - it makes divergence AUDITABLE by splitting one fog into three distinguishable failure modes. Runs in parallel with PRECEDENT.md v1 (T-357) and with the code (T-353/T-354); cross-consistency and code drift are caught at T-360.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE: INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md at the REPO ROOT - a new tracked file, sibling of PRECEDENT.md. Acquire `python3 .harness/bin/lock.py acquire INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md --holder <you> --task T-356` before writing. Do NOT edit PRECEDENT.md (T-357 owns it and is running concurrently), do NOT touch anything under .harness/, do NOT edit any docs/ research file.

WRITE THE RULE LIST THE SYNTHESIS FIXED, completely: every IC-NN id in docs/precedent-research/synthesis-v1-requirements.md's rule list appears, with its class (translation | preference | procedure) and its normative content. No rule the synthesis did not fix; no rule the synthesis fixed left out. If you believe a rule is wrong, record a DEVIATION note and implement it anyway - this is constitutional-tier material and the synthesis is its authority, not your judgment.

VERSIONED AND MACHINE-READABLE: the document declares its version (v1) in the exact form and exact location the synthesis fixed, so a CLI could read it - because every registry record will carry an interpretive_code_version field that cites it. State the amendment route inside the document itself: constitutional-tier, amendable only through the overruling-grade protocol (A3, addendum section 4), never by ordinary edit.

THE CODE-VERSION CITATION DUTY IS A RULE, NOT PROSE COLOUR: state as a numbered rule that every interpretive act recorded in the registry cites the code version used (addendum section 4). State what a reader does when a record cites a version that no longer exists, and state the diagnostic payoff plainly: two sessions that disagree either read different dispositions, used different code versions, or applied the same code differently - three distinguishable failure modes instead of one fog.

THE PURPOSE CLAUSE, stated honestly: the code does NOT eliminate indeterminacy, which is structural (vagueness, ambiguity, unforeseen application contexts, competing methods, competing background theories - addendum section 1.3). It makes indeterminacy AUDITABLE. A document that promises determinacy misstates its own theory and will be rejected at T-360.

CITE THE ADDENDUM BY DOI, NEVER BY LOCAL PATH: use DOI 10.22201/iij.24487937e.2026.20.20316 plus the section number, and name the author (Mario Armando Sandoval Islas), the venue (Problema. Anuario de Filosofia y Teoria del Derecho 20, IIJ-UNAM, 2026) and the school (Genoese legal realism: Tarello, Guastini, Chiassoni). A docs/ path citation is FORBIDDEN in this file: docs/ is gitignored (.gitignore:33, verified) so the path would dangle for every reader who clones the repo.

CROSS-DOCUMENT DISCIPLINE: reference PRECEDENT.md by document name and SECTION HEADING, never by line number - line numbers rot, and T-346 caught exactly this in the v0 document (a stale cite at PRECEDENT.md:36 plus five path citations the layer's own resolver flags as dangling). Do NOT restate rules that live in PRECEDENT.md or ORCHESTRATION.md; cite them. Measured basis for the extends-not-duplicates contract: stacking a layer that re-does existing verification regressed the corpus system by 2.3pp, the only regression among four single-component swaps (papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8 Table 3 RQ3a, p.9).

DO NOT QUOTE CLI --help TEXT OR EXIT CODES YOU CANNOT VERIFY: this document is written in parallel with the code by design. Where a rule implies a command, cite the synthesis's fixed CLI surface as the authority and let T-360 catch drift against the shipped binary. Fabricating a transcript is the exact failure this epic exists to detect.

NO EMOJIS anywhere in the file. Include a section stating plainly what this document does NOT do - in particular whether any agent is yet OBLIGED to consult or cite the code, and that incorporating such a duty into claude.md or gemini.md is an NLAH mutation requiring the section 5A loop plus the human gate (ORCHESTRATION.md:225-229) and is out of scope for this epic.
NO ABSOLUTE USER PATHS and no sibling-project names anywhere in the file: it is a tracked artifact in a public repo, and T-348 found exactly this class of leak as a commit blocker.

Hand off with `python3 .harness/bin/blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier --agent <you>` (never self-mark done). The note lists every IC-NN id written with its class, and every DEVIATION from the synthesis rule list. Verification tier: constitutional-doc tier at T-360 - completeness against the synthesis rule list, the version string, the DOI citation, and cross-consistency with PRECEDENT.md v1.
